### enhanceCigaretteCards()

```ts
function enhanceCigaretteCards(root?): () => void;
```

Flip server-rendered CigaretteCards on click, tap, Enter or Space. The card is a
native button, so the keyboard reaches it as a click; this only toggles the
pressed state. Returns a cleanup that removes the listener.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type                        | Default value |
| --------- | --------------------------- | ------------- |
| `root`    | `Document` \| `HTMLElement` | `document`    |

#### Returns

() => `void`
